gen-gf-grandstander-gf-cossette-texte: Bold and brash would be wrong; think expressive, with Grandstander drawing every line at a single width. Cossette Texte follows in sans-serif, its wide-eyed e and generous x-height keeping paragraphs easy to move through.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-duru-sans: Chunky, playful, a bit like bent rod. Duru Sans takes over in a plain sans with low-slung ascenders and wide-open small letters, so a long stretch of it flows along without any fuss.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-fresca: Grandstander's uniform, uncurled strokes and short ascenders give it a cheerful, hand-built punch, and Fresca slides underneath with big bowls and connected counters. Together the two feel modern and open, one loud and one easygoing.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans reads crisp and tidy, with strokes that hold steady and an e opened wide. Funnel Sans over a long stretch stays smooth and unfussy, while Grandstander up top supplies the expressive shouting.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-gafata: Grandstander draws every stem and join at the same weight, so its bold, expressive letters feel stamped rather than penned. Gafata's tall, wide-eyed letters sit quietly under it.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-geist: Grandstander's lines never thicken or thin, loud and round. Geist sits beneath in quiet, level sans-serif, its words forming solid blocks that let the heading take all the attention.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-georama: Approachable describes the whole pairing: Grandstander's round letters have rims matching their stems, while Georama's open c and low capitals stay relaxed in a plain sans. The difference in height is the point.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-gidole: Rounded, bold, and uniform like neon tube. Gidole follows in a plain sans whose terminals stay apart and whose midline sits high, giving the pair a crisp, consistent drawn quality.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-golos-text: Loud, uncurled letters with a tall x-height. Grandstander is built for making noise, while Golos Text, a sans with a generous x-height and an open s, is built for carrying the words quietly along.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Expressive and bold, Grandstander even draws its w without thick or thin strokes. Grandstander is made to announce, whereas Hedvig Letters Sans, a sans-serif with small letters nearly as tall as capitals, is made to explain.
